start: The village is dark. Pip finds the last light capsule in the workshop.
outcome: Pip and Ada repair and test the damaged bridge. Pip delivers the light capsule and restores the lighthouse and village lanterns.
learned: Pip learns to inspect connections, repair weak points, and test before trusting.
